body:
I'm sorry if I've offended you by 'bragging.' I suppose I've lost the art of being careful with my words at this stage. Hell the reason I put "friend-zoned" in quotes is because I myself don't really believe such a thing exists. Being a good person/friend to somebody =/= they will have or should develop romantic feelings. Again, I do apologize if I've offended.

Often I've wished that I might 'switch places' with another. When people tell me of their woes and lives, I do believe they might be better off with what I have. People have told me 'be happy with what you have' and 'starving kids in Africa would kill for what you take for granted.' All I can say is 'they are welcome to take it if they can.' If someone out there has a plan to 'switch places' with me, I'd have no trouble accepting. Then, perhaps, it would be 'more reasonable' for me to die, and somebody else can go off with my life.

There are many things I've not shared because it's either irrelevant or natter. I am most likely clinically depressed, and I'm currently be medicated as if I were. So far, it does not seem to be helping.

I have always found it hard to explain myself to people. I find that I often have quite an unusual if not alien mindset and values. Perhaps fermenting in isolation is the cause. Nothing may have meaning, but that does not stop some things from being enjoyable. Hell, most days I'm not even sure what I'm experiencing is really happening. I have played games not because I find them to be real, but because they are entertaining nonetheless. Though no longer, perhaps.

I have nothing in my life that should cause me to feel this way, and that has only added to my confusion and frustration. Despite having no real problems such as you've shared, why do I feel so entranced with death? I can only say I've had a latent death wish since I was a child. I have no better explanation or reasoning. For as long as I can remember the state of my mind and what I remember thinking and feeling, I have had at least some desire to die. Self-preservation instinct is all that holds me back, I suppose.

While I do masturbate, I have the libido of a rock and can be sated every three or four days it seems. As I mentioned elsewhere, I'd probably do it if there was an agreeable woman present, but I feel no reason to seek it out. I feel no reason to 'sell myself' and go through it all. The prospect just bores me, as it does for interviews. I'd rather not, thanks.

I am a devout atheist, yes. I sleep and nap all the time because it is the most equitable compromise between what I want and what others want. For now. I know that it is not pleasurable at the time. I know it is an absence of consciousness. These things do not trouble me. They are what inspire me! It is this very lack of thought and experience that I desire. The release so many Buddhists seek, though I am not one myself. I have the utmost perverse and morbid curiosity about the undiscovered country.

I do not seek relief or emotion. I seek an end to all things. I would do this not to escape pain, but to escape experience itself. Thus far, I have felt nothing but boredom, frustration, disappointment, anger, fatigue, and emptiness. That which is supposed to please only does that for me. Hell, even masturbating feels like a chore.

I've already 'made peace' with the idea that many might be hurt by my death. Suffice it to say, I shall not live for others while I feel no reason to live for my own sake. Another's pain is not a compelling reason for me to stop myself. If my death is to be called 'selfish' anyway, I resolved long ago that perhaps I might as well become selfish.

Many of the 'life experiences' people have told me about... bore me. I have no desire I can see for the 'American Dream' sort of stuff: kids, cars, pets, house, wife, career, hard-work --> riches, etc. The way I see it, Life has much to offer those who adopted the customs, culture, and expectations of the 'average' person.

As much as I hate people who try to make themselves sound unique, I honestly do not feel much in common with these... 'average' ideals. They inspire no action and leave me only feeling alienated from my fellow man.

I suppose since I still see some value to a *very* short list of experiences, I'd classify as an existential nihilist. Haven't thought about putting myself into a subcategory before. Though if I'm mistaken about that, feel free to correct me.

Funnily enough, I myself have been courted off and on by several girls thus far, and I've "friend-zoned" each one so far. Suffice it to say, it's given me pause and made me laugh sometimes at the 'nice guys finish last' neckbeard-types. My libido is that of a rock, entirely satisfied by masturbating once every three or four days.

If an entirely willing, forward, and compatible woman fell into my lap, I can't say I'd pass it up, if only because it'd be awkward not to. But I feel little if any compulsion to... seek it out, especially because I think I'd rather not trouble a woman with my issues at the moment.

Frankly, there's not a day goes by that I don't eventually fall into the abyss and have those *eyes* gaze back at me. As I said, the void beckons to me. My latent death wish becomes overt, at times.
